notes.title: Bionic Slammer – Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It’s been a while since we last shared any news, and we wanted to reassure you: Bionic Slammer is still in development! We are a very small team of three people (including one musician), and the project is progressing at its own pace. This is not a full-time development, as we sometimes need to focus on other projects to make a living. Right now, only one person is actively working on the game, and we will release it when it’s ready. We apologize for the silence and truly appreciate your patience.

If you’d like to stay updated, we encourage you to add the game to your Steam wishlist. We are no longer on X/Twitter and are not very active online, so this is the best way to receive updates and be notified when we have important news to share.

At the end of 2024, we released a playable demo of Bionic Slammer on itch.io. While this demo is based on an early prototype and may still contain issues, it already gives a good idea of what the game will be like. You can try it right now by either downloading the Windows version or playing the HTML version directly on the itch.io page.

We may release the demo (or a different one) on Steam in the future when we have something new to showcase. In the meantime, your feedback on the itch.io demo is incredibly valuable! Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments to let us know if you’d like to play a full game based on this experience.

A huge thank you to everyone following our progress and to those who have added Bionic Slammer to their Steam wishlist. Your support means a lot to us! If you enjoy the project, please spread the word and share it on your networks—it really helps us!

See you soon for more updates!

The Bionic Slammer Team

notes.title: Bionic Slammer revealed
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

After several months of secret work, we're very happy to finally reveal our project of metroidvania Bionic Slammer. 

It's just a reveal today, but more details will be coming in the future, so stay tuned. Please consider to add Bionic Slammer to your wishlist if you're curious about our game! 

Among the things that you shouldn't miss today:


 The Steam page with the description of the game (also available by linking through www.bionicslammer.com)
 The Reveal Trailer, on the Steam page or on Youtube: https://youtu.be/Wl-7LiUNVyU
More videos will be added later, showing more gameplay. 
 Screenshots from the Trailer. We don't want to spoil too much at this stage of the project, everything is still in development. But some more definitive HD screenshots will be published as soon as possible. 
 The website of Team-Icehouse working on the game: www.team-icehouse.com 
And our Twitter account: @team_icehouse
In case you'd like to follow us there for future updates...


And don't forget that it's just the reveal. Honestly we're showing already quite a lot of the game for a first announcement! So we hope you'll be happy and excited because we are! 

You can ask us anything in the community area, or contact us on social networks. 

We're counting on your help to share the news and let more people know about Bionic Slammer. 

Until next time!

Simon & Team-Icehouse
